text:
carol: FYI we've got a 12m eviction wave in ap-south1 starting 04:08 UTC. Tiny GPU pods are bouncing and some jobs hit OOM backoff.

diego: I see it in scheduler traces. A maintenance relabel job briefly cleared gpu-family labels on ~18 nodes, scheduler preempted pods that then couldn't bind because the label was absent.

maya: Also noticed high pod reschedule failures ~15, and kubelet restarted on 4 nodes (kubelet churn) likely due to node relabel side-effects.

ops-bot: [alert] evictions.spike(ap-south1) 7999994444 - 51 evictions in 12m, resched_fail=15

andre: Short-term: pause relabeler cron in ap-south1, bump warm-pool min replicas +2, and set scheduler --max-preemptions-per-second=1 for the region. Rollable commands ready.

carol: Do it. Also add a temporary scheduler predicate to ignore nodes with label-change-age < 120s.

diego: Will open ENG-PLAT follow-ups: relabeler two-phase, add label-change metric, and harden relabeler to avoid removing labels to "unknown".

maya: Canary applied in ap-south1-a; eviction rate dropped to baseline after actions. Will monitor for 1h and draft runbook entry.
